meta.description: Use when verifying or auditing a Cull release, DMG, updater archive, notarization, Homebrew cask, installed version, launch health, or post-publication distribution state.

copy.tagline: 验证 Cull 发布版本的完整性与正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责软件发布流程，需要确保发布包符合规范
copy.tagline_en: Verify the integrity and correctness of a Cull release
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage software releases and need to ensure distribution artifacts meet standards

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude会帮你从公共证据验证Cull发布的真实性，检查Git标签、工件签名、哈希值、公证等，默认只读取不修改。
howto.when: 当你需要验证或审计Cull的发布、DMG、更新归档、公证、Homebrew cask、已安装版本或分发状态时触发。

say.text: 验证最新Cull发布的完整性。
审计这个Cull DMG文件的签名和公证。
检查Cull Homebrew cask的版本和哈希是否匹配。

howto.what_en: Install this skill to enable Claude to reconstruct release truth from immutable public evidence, verifying Git tags, artifact signatures, checksums, notarization, etc. Read-only by default.
howto.when_en: Use when verifying or auditing a Cull release, DMG, updater archive, notarization, Homebrew cask, installed version, launch health, or post-publication distribution state.

say_en.text: Verify the latest Cull release integrity.
Audit this Cull DMG for signature and notarization.
Check Cull Homebrew cask version and hash match.
say_en.note: Claude compares Homebrew with published data.
